scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,viewer,extension -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm --filter viewer dev" "pnpm --filter extension dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter viewer build && pnpm --filter extension build
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && uv run --project server --python 3.14 pytest
scripts.check: pnpm -r check && uv run --project server --python 3.14 ruff check . && uv run --project server --python 3.14 pytest
